The Punjab State Power Corporation Limited has released the PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 for the Junior Engineer (Electrical) recruitment on 17th July 2026 on its official website. Candidates who appeared for the online exam held on 16th June 2025 can now download the result to check their qualifying status and marks. The result PDF includes the names and roll numbers of the candidates who cleared the exam. Scroll down to get the direct link to download the PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 PDF.

PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 Out

The PSPCL Junior Engineer Final Result 2026 has been announced by the Punjab State Power Corporation Limited. Candidates who appeared in the online examination can now check their qualification status. A total of 5,734 candidates appeared in the exam, of which 3,541 candidates qualified for the Junior Engineer (Electrical) post. Candidates can download the combined merit list @pspcl.in and check their name, roll number, category and qualification status along with the marks scored in the written exam.

PSPCL JE Result 2026: Overview

The Punjab State Power Corporation Limited conducted recruitment for Junior Engineer (JE) vacancies under Advertisement No. CRA 303/24 on 16th June 2025. Candidates who appeared in the exam can check more details regarding recruitment below.

Written Exam 16th June 2025
Candidates Appeared 5734
Candidates Qualified 3,541
PSPCL JE Final Result Date 17th July 2026
Result Status Released

PSPCL JE 2026 Final Result Download PDF

The PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 PDF has been released on the official website of Punjab State Power Corporation Limited. The merit list contains the names, roll numbers, marks obtained, category and qualifying status of the shortlisted candidates. Candidates can download the PDF and use the Ctrl + F shortcut to quickly search for their roll number or name. Those whose names appear in the merit list are considered qualified for the post. Click on the link below to download the result PDF.

PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 PDF: Click to Download 

How to Check the PSPCL JE Final Result 2026?

The PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 is now available online on the official PSPCL website. Candidates can download the merit list PDF and check their qualifying status by searching their roll number or name. Follow the given steps to check result.

  1. Visit the official PSPCL website.
  2. Go to the Recruitment or Careers section.
  3. Click on the PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 link.
  4. Download the merit list PDF.
  5. Press Ctrl + F and enter your Roll Number or Name.
  6. The qualification status as Y or N is mentioned in the PDF along with marks.

Details Mentioned in PSPCL JE Final Result PDF

The PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 PDF contains important information about the candidates who appeared for the recruitment exam. Candidates should carefully check and report any discrepancy to the authorities if found.

  • Candidate Name
  • Roll Number
  • Application Reference Number
  • Father Name
  • Gender
  • Category
  • PwD Status
  • Date of Birth
  • Marks Obtained (out of 100)
  • Qualifying Status
  • Rank/Merit Position

PSPCL JE 2026 Result FAQs

Q. When was PSPCL JE written exam 2026 held?
A. The PSPCL Junior Engineer Exam was held on 26th June 2026.

Q. When is PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 released?

A. The PSPCL JE Final Result 2026 in released on 17th July 2026.

Q. Where can i download the PSPCL JE Result 2026?

A. Candidates can download the PSPCL JE Result from official PSPCL website.

Q. What if I’m not qualified for the PSPCL JE 2026?

A. Candidates who do not qualify for the PSPCL JE 2026 can appear for the next recruitment cycle.

Q. How many candidates qualified for PSPCL Junior Engineer 2026?

A. A total of 3541 candidates qualified in PSPCL JE Exam 2026.
